description: This Dart class 'SecureTokenStore' provides an abstraction for securely storing, retrieving, and deleting authentication tokens (access token, refresh token, expiration time) using the 'flutter_secure_storage' package. It interacts with platform-specific secure storage (iOS Keychain and Android EncryptedSharedPreferences).

classes.name: SecureTokenStore
classes.description: A class that manages secure storage of authentication tokens, including access token, refresh token, and token expiry time.

methods.name: writeTokens
methods.description: Stores the access token, refresh token, and expiry time into secure storage.

methods.name: readAccessTokenExpiryEpochSeconds
methods.description: Retrieves the expiry time of the access token as an integer epoch seconds.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Deletes all stored token data from secure storage.
